link.description: Post-process effects applied to any node via the `effects` prop. Blur, grayscale, pixelate, bloom, directional blur, motion blur, radial blur, chromatic aberration, bulge, magnify, invert, scatter, posterize, threshold, dither, halftone, edges, sharpen, outline, vignette, grain, duotone, curves, color adjustment, vintage, and background blur.
